Northshore Community Hospital DISCHARGE SUMMARY - Obstetrics (admitted through the Emergency Department) Patient: LINDQVIST, RENATA J MRN: RC-2208-314 DOB: 03/14/2025 Page 1 of 2 Admission date: 09/28/2070 Discharge date: 09/30/2070 Attending: Dr. Fatima Al-Rashidi (ED), Dr. Joaquim Pereira (OB) Wristband text: *RC2208314* Cord blood kit CBK-2070-558812 (sticker on baby chart) Dictated by Joaquim Pereira MD. Dictated but not read.
DIAGNOSES: 1. Term pregnancy, spontaneous labor, normal vaginal delivery of a live female infant. 2. Advanced maternal age. 3. Chronic migraine history is NOT relevant, see template error below.
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: Ms Lindqvist is a 45 year old gravida 3 para 2 woman, formerly Renata Castellanos, who called our line on the evening of the 27th with regular contractions and was sent to the emergency department where she was met by Dr Al-Rashidi. She was found to be 6 cm dilated, fully effaced, at zero station and was transferred directly to labour and delivery. Her husband Anders Lindqvist was present throughout. She has a stepson, Oskar, who is fourteen, and her mother Lucia Castellanos flew in from Phoenix on the 29th.
Her social history is as follows. She worked part time at Harbourline Cafe as a barista until the pregnancy, lives with her husband and stepson in a rented upstairs apartment, her landlady is Mrs Vance and the neighbor downstairs, Mr Hakeem Rahimi, has been very helpfull. She denies tobacco and drug use. Husband is employed as a ferry pilot.
HOSPITAL COURSE: Labour was uncomplicated and she delivered at 23:51 on 09/28/2070 a live born female weighing 3.1 kg, Apgars 8 and 9. Epidural was not used. Estimated blood loss 350. Placenta delivered intact. The baby, named Matilda Lindqvist (Mathilda on the birth certificate worksheet, to be corrected), roomed in and fed well. Mother's blood pressure remained normal.
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS: iron ferrous sulfate 325 daily, prenatal vitamin, Camila (norethindrone) stopped; contraception plan to be discussed at the postnatal visit. Simvastatin on hold. FOLLOW UP: Postnatal visit 11/09/2070 with Dr. Voss; baby to Lakehead Pediatrics within 2 days.
